responsibility: Implements the common AST-visitor base used by the Rust AST name-resolution passes. This file provides the shared visibility-path resolver and default no-op visit methods for the full Rust AST, so specialized resolvers such as expression, item, statement, pattern, and type resolvers only override the node kinds they actually process while still sharing access to the global Resolver state, mappings, and resolved-node tracking.
same_name_distinction: Defines the out-of-line behavior for ResolverBase: the shared visibility-path resolver and the large set of default empty AST visitor methods that derived resolvers inherit. Unlike the matching header, this file supplies the executable fallback implementations rather than the class interface and shared state layout.
